title: Stable Identity, Versioning & Synchronization
objective: Implement a bounded provider-neutral stable-identity, versioning and synchronization contract for derivative external VTT projections while Multiversal remains canonical authority.

authorized: provider-neutral stable external-object mappings between Multiversal canonical source references and derivative external-object identities
deterministic fingerprints and version negotiation for synchronization decisions
stale and conflict detection, reconnect, deduplication, tombstones and MIB-03 retry/recovery semantics
visibility, ownership, consent, hidden-information filtering and GM-authority constraints preserved in synchronization metadata
acceptance fixtures, deterministic normalization, invariant validation and receipts needed to prove the bounded contract
not_authorized: rules actions, rolls, attacks, checks, powers, initiative, reactions or resolution bridging reserved to VTI-04
provider-specific schemas, vendor selection or VTI-09 platform commitment
credentials, external account mutation, adapter implementation or canonical game-state mutation
durable VTI persistence or a new migration before separately authorized persistence work
live external synchronization mutation, package distribution, provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment

governed_start_boundaries: VTI-02 remains completed_verified and frozen with its implementation authority retired.
Multiversal remains canonical rules/campaign authority; external VTT state is derivative and may not supersede canonical Multiversal state.
VTI-03 bounded production-contract authority is unlocked only after genuine matching acceptance RED; live external synchronization mutation remains unauthorized.

External-object mapping, fingerprints, version negotiation, stale/conflict detection, reconnect, deduplication, tombstones and MIB-03 retry/recovery semantics are in VTI-03 scope as pure deterministic contract behavior.
Visibility, ownership, consent, hidden-information filtering and GM authority remain mandatory preserved constraints across synchronization metadata.
Provider-specific schemas and vendor selection remain deferred; platform selection remains evidence-driven at VTI-09.
VTI-04 rules-action/roll bridging, durable persistence/new migration, credentials/external accounts/adapters, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Implement only packages/contracts/src/virtual-tabletop-interoperability/stable-identity-versioning-synchronization-contract.ts on the existing application branch, then prove exact-head repository health, Linux GREEN, Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison before merge.
